photos.c: Above: It's all to play for on the last lap of the last event in the Guardian Insurance Gold Cup Final - the 4 x 400 metres. Matthew Kloiber (48.5) hands the baton to Dave Nolan (46.6) but the 'Beagles' are at the head of the pack.
